items.text: I can explain what Object Lock is and when to use it
I know the difference between Governance Mode and Compliance Mode
I understand what WORM storage means and can give a real-world example
I can explain the difference between SSE-S3, SSE-KMS, and SSE-C
I understand how DEK (Data Encryption Key) works with KMS
I can explain why S3 Bucket Key reduces costs without reducing security
I understand what lifecycle transition and expiration actions do
I know the difference between CRR and SRR and when to use each
I can explain the HTTPS limitation of S3 static website hosting
I can enable Object Lock on an S3 bucket and apply Compliance Mode to an object
I can create a Customer Managed Key in KMS and configure S3 to use SSE-KMS
I can build a KMS Key ARN in the correct arn:aws:kms:region:account:key/id format
I can create a lifecycle rule to transition and expire objects by age
I can configure Cross-Region Replication between two versioning-enabled buckets
I can enable S3 static website hosting and write the correct public read bucket policy
I know Object Lock requires versioning — and can explain why
I know SSE-S3 is the default and SSE-KMS is the production standard
I can identify what DEK stands for and what actually encrypts S3 data in SSE-KMS
I know Replication only applies to new objects — existing objects need Batch Replication
I know S3 website hosting is HTTP-only and HTTPS requires CloudFront + ACM
I know Compliance Mode blocks even AWS from modifying locked objects
